facts.fact: New Ground 在伦敦北部一条安静的住宅路上，紧挨着热闹的商业街。
facts.anchor: Tucked away on a quiet residential road off a bustling high street in north London is New Ground

facts.fact: OWCH 为这栋砖砌公寓楼争取了将近二十年。
facts.anchor: spent almost two decades fighting for was this wonderful brick house

facts.fact: 2016 年底入住以来，这里成了二十六位女性的家。
facts.anchor: dream come true for twenty-six of us since the end of 2016

facts.fact: 这是英国第一个专为五十岁以上女性建造的共居社区。
facts.anchor: the first purpose-built cohousing community for women over fifty in the UK

facts.fact: 1998 年，一封邀请出现在报纸和伦敦各社区团体的布告栏上。
facts.anchor: the invitation that appeared in the newspaper and on noticeboards of London community groups in 1998

facts.fact: 邀请由大学讲师、研究者 Maria Brenton 撰写，她此前访问过荷兰的共居社区。
facts.anchor: written by university lecturer and researcher Maria Brenton

facts.fact: OWCH 在入住前为社会保障房租户争取到八套房子。
facts.anchor: secure eight of the flats for social housing tenants

facts.fact: 赫迪（Hedi）九十六岁，是社区里最年长的居民之一。
